>> Tonight's results.
Tonight's results are a wake-up call for
corporate special interests and
billionaires who have been rigging the
economy, for the cowards in Congress who
have enabled healthcare cuts, tariffs,
and war, and for the incompetent
president who can't even be bothered to

So tonight, voters in New Hampshire and
all across the country simply have had
enough enough and are demanding a change
in direction. And I am ready to fight
with everything I've got to deliver the
change that we need.

This has been a long campaign
against a backdrop of the chaos,
corruption, and costs coming out of
Washington.

America needs a course correction,
that Washington needs a new generation
at the table to fix things,

leadership to stand up and get stuff
done.

gracious call from John Sununu.

well, and I wish the same for him and

Sununu a a big debt of gratitude for his

Hampshire.
[cheering]
[applause]
So tonight,
whether you're a Republican, an
independent, or a Democrat, tonight's
victory is for you because this is a

So tonight, tonight we don't celebrate a
victory for any one political party. We
celebrate a victory for anyone, left,
right, or center, struggling with the
skyrocketing costs of living, from gas
to groceries to housing. Anyone who's
sick of the tariffs, the endless war,
the tax breaks for big corporations paid
for by cuts to your healthcare. Anyone
who's fed up with the most corrupt
president in our history, who has failed
in his way of governing. And anyone who
knows that we can do so much better if
we work together.
So we know this was a hard-fought
victory tonight.
It was made even harder by the tens and
tens of millions of dollars that poured
into New Hampshire from Donald Trump,
Elon Musk, and corporate special
interests who are just fine
who are just fine with the way things
are going right now. They threw money,
attack ads, and outright lies at us
every day for months.
But we beat them anyway, didn't we?
[cheering]
We're the people people powered
campaign. A campaign of 200,000
individual donors and not a dime from

And we showed what happens when we stick

long.
